[email.md]
# Email access — fictional sample policy

For email access problems, check the email service status and try the approved
webmail application. If webmail works but a desktop client fails, record the
client name and error message for a support ticket. Do not attach private
message contents or share account passwords.


[vpn.md]
# VPN troubleshooting — fictional sample policy

For a failed campus VPN connection, first check the VPN service status.
Confirm ordinary internet access works, then restart the VPN client and retry.
Use the campus-approved VPN client on a managed device.
If the issue persists, draft a support ticket with the error message, device
operating system, approximate failure time, and steps already tried.
Do not include passwords or MFA verification codes in the ticket.


[wifi.md]
# Campus WiFi troubleshooting — fictional sample policy

For WiFi connection problems, check the WiFi service status and confirm you
selected the campus network. Disable and re-enable WiFi, then retry.
If only one device is affected, restart that device. If the issue persists,
draft a support ticket containing the building, device operating system,
error message, and approximate failure time. Do not share passwords.
